title: Grateful Dead Live at Hartford Civic Center on 1982-04-17
lineage: SBD> PCM> C> DAT> ZA2 downsampling> CDR

ai_review.summary: High‑quality soundboard capture of an above‑average ’82 show highlighted by a stellar Baby Blue and tight Lost Sailor jam.
ai_review.review: The recording is a clean, well‑balanced soundboard tape with excellent separation and crisp drums, only occasional guitar crackles that reviewers attribute to Jerry’s “smokin’” tone. Musically the concert sits above average for 1982 – the second‑set gems like Baby Blue, Lost Sailor/Circumstance and a fiery Shakedown Street showcase tight interplay and strong vocals, making it a solid highlight of the spring ’82 run.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently positive reviews (4‑5 stars) praise both the musical performance and the soundboard quality; only minor technical quirks are noted, yielding a strong combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear separation, no muddiness, well‑mic'd drums and cymbals, solid bass; occasional crackles/pops on guitar are noted but considered part of Jerry’s tone rather than a flaw.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First nine songs are missing, but the remaining second‑set material flows strongly with tight jams and emotional vocals; the encore Baby Blue is repeatedly singled out as a highlight.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia’s guitar described as “smokin’”; vocal phrasing praised as still strong for early ’82.
band_member_comments.Phil: Phil’s bass noted as fully engaged and solid throughout the jams.
band_member_comments.Bob: Bob Weir “lets it loose” with good chord interaction, especially on NFA.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent (keyboards) shines, leading the Spanish‑style jam; keyboards described as well balanced.
band_member_comments.Drums: Drums and cymbals are well mic'd and recorded, providing a clear rhythmic foundation.
